luksong_baka.name: Luksong Baka
luksong_baka.tagline: Time your jump over the baka.
rules: Run toward the cardboard baka and press SPACE at the right moment to jump.
Each wave the baka gets taller and the timing window shrinks.
Miss your timing and you are out. The last one standing scores 10 points.

agawan_base.name: Agawan Base
agawan_base.tagline: Reach the enemy base without getting tagged.
rules: Two teams, two bases. Reach the enemy base to score a point.
Whoever left their base later can tag players who left earlier.
A tag pauses the game. The tagged player waits to be rescued by a teammate.
First team to 3 points, or the most points when time runs out, wins.

tumbang_preso.name: Tumbang Preso
tumbang_preso.tagline: Knock down the can. Dodge the Taya.
rules: Throw your tsinelas at the can from the throw line.
When the can falls, the Taya must set it up while you grab your slipper.
Get tagged outside the safe zone and you become the Taya.
Knock down the can for 2 points. Tag a thrower for 3 points.
